name: Zogem
source:
He is a giant of a man who heads a group of opposition parties. He is selfish and arrogant, and will do anything dirty to get money and women.

As a result, he was able to assume the position of effective leader of the frontier fortress.
He is plotting to capture the abominable Celicia, who leads the Guard of Honor.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/kuro_hina/selicia/index.html]official site[/url]]
